emailSettings.title: Email settings
emailSettings.fake: Demo mode: no external emails are sent.
emailSettings.description: Configure qualification and email automation for this business.
emailSettings.address: Physical mailing address for email footers
emailSettings.catalogHelp: Select services from your business catalog. Availability uses its staff, business hours and connected calendar.
emailSettings.noServices: Add an active service before saving email settings.
emailSettings.followupHelp: Only leads with recorded consent receive follow-ups. Replies, bookings and opt-outs stop them. Delays are increasing hours from the first delivered response, for example 24, 72, 168. Daily caps use UTC.
emailSettings.saveFailed: Unable to save. Check service selection, ZIPs, emergency text and follow-up schedule, then retry.
emailSettings.tokenHelp: The token is shown only when created or replaced. Keep a copy for your capture integration.
emailSettings.rotateWarning: I understand that replacing the token stops existing capture forms until they are updated.
emailSettings.rotateFailed: Unable to replace the token. Try again.
emailSettings.aliases: Alternate service names, separated by commas
emailSettings.snippetHelp: Save and enable email processing, then paste this snippet into your website HTML where you want the form.

resumeHelp: Resuming takes effect on the next incoming reply.
